description: This file contains implementation of the TestConnectJobDelegate class, which is used for testing connection jobs in the net namespace. It includes methods for handling connection completion, proxy authentication, waiting for authentication challenges, running authentication callbacks, and managing socket resources.

classes.name: TestConnectJobDelegate
classes.description: A test delegate class for handling connect job events, including completion, proxy auth, and socket management.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Handles the completion of a connect job, storing the result and socket, and quitting the run loop.

methods.name: OnNeedsProxyAuth
methods.description: Handles proxy authentication challenges, storing response info and auth controller, and managing the auth challenge run loop.

methods.name: WaitForAuthChallenge
methods.description: Waits until the specified number of auth challenges have been received.

methods.name: RunAuthCallback
methods.description: Runs the stored restart with auth callback.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Runs the main run loop until a result is available and returns it.

methods.name: StartJobExpectingResult
methods.description: Starts a connect job and expects a specific result, handling synchronous and asynchronous cases.

methods.name: ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases ownership of the socket and returns it.
